name: icos
description: A powerful, adaptive, and intelligent operating system by ICY.

scripts.package:desktop:win: npm run build && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win
scripts.package:desktop:mac: npm run build && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac
scripts.package:desktop:linux: npm run build && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux
scripts.mobile:sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
